name: 0032 - CLI ergonomics: runs headers/filters + cfd prepare/mesh-evidence polish (R4+R5)

jobs.title: Land R4 (runs CLI header + filter docs) and R5 (CFD CLI polish)
jobs.objective: Close audit findings AUD-O-004 (R4), AUD-O-005 and AUD-O-006 (R5) per docs/audits/2026-05-22-code-doc-audit/REMEDIATION_PLAN.md. Add an opt-in --header / --no-header flag to `kayakgen runs list` and `kayakgen runs jobs` (default --no-header for back-compat); when --header is set, print a `#`-prefixed header listing the columns each command already writes. Extend the --filter help on `runs query` and `runs jobs` to enumerate the actual filter keys the implementation honors (don't invent restrictions). Append one line to the `mesh-evidence` env-var refusal naming RFC 0046's three opt-in mechanisms and that mesh-evidence currently honors only the env-knob mechanism; append one line to the `cfd prepare` success path naming `kayakgen cfd run <job_dir>` as the next step plus the three opt-in mechanisms. Update `docs/USER_GUIDE.md` `### runs` to document --header and enumerate filter keys (one short paragraph + one code example). Do not touch CHANGELOG, FINDINGS, kayakgen/eval/contract.py, kayakgen/eval/stability/, tests/test_vocabulary_coverage.py, or kayakgen/ui/web/.

jobs.title: Review R4+R5 patches for scope, copy fidelity, and test impact
jobs.objective: Review the implement job's patch for (1) staying inside the named write scope; (2) preserving back-compat — runs list / jobs default output rows are unchanged byte-for-byte when --header is absent; (3) the appended mesh-evidence and cfd prepare lines name RFC 0046 plus the three opt-in mechanisms verbatim; (4) the --filter help text matches the actual filterable keys in SqliteIndex / runs_query_command implementation, not invented keys; (5) the USER_GUIDE addition is tight (one paragraph + one example); (6) the cfd_jobs* test suite still passes. Publish a finding artifact with one of accept | accept_with_findings | needs_revision | reject.
